title: get_my_queue output
description: The response envelope. On success, data lists what needs the person. An approval points to its decision page, where the person answers it (answer_approval, served only on the web app's entry, D-38). An AI client is never offered a tool that answers one. Each item says whether an AI client created its record and who last wrote it, as the engine stamped it.

kind.description: approval: a request the person may answer now. review: a due review on an application they own, or one whose outcome decision they may propose (C24 Produces Decision Type and their Decision Right, C31). document: a required document missing (computed, never stored), stale by date or marked stale, or a draft waiting for their confirmation. claim: a claim suggested to them. draft: their draft, or a decision they proposed and have not submitted. owner-gap: an owner role with no holder or deputy on their application. data-gap: a data finding that names the person, such as a domain they own with no deputy (OP-17); for the platform admin and the data governance lead also the findings nobody owns yet. A draft also covers data uses, mappings and locations an AI client drafted for the person.

subjectKind.description: The entity key of the subject, such as decision or intake-request.

subjectId.description: The ID of the subject row, or the domain key for a data domain.

title.description: A short title for the item.

businessApplicationId.description: The application the item is about, if any.

dueOn.description: When it is due, if it has a due date.

status.description: The subject's status, if it has one.

why.description: Why the item is in the queue, in one plain sentence.

recordUrl.description: Opens the record, or the decision page for an approval.

nextTool.description: The tool that helps with this item. For an approval, answer_approval on the person entry (the web app, D-38), and null for an AI client, which never answers an approval.

isAiCreated.description: True when an AI client created the item's record. False for a computed item (a missing document, an owner gap) and for a seeded record.

performedBy.description: Who last wrote the item's record, as the engine stamped it (for an approval, its decision). Null for a computed item and for a row the engine never stamped.
